We say Uruguay 2-0 South Korea. Uruguay have been near faultless under Alonso since his appointment a year ago, and with their elite forwards and a solid defence, they should be big favourites here.
[...]
In terms of goals for the game, the bookies don’t expect to see many goals with average odds on under 2.5 total goals being 5/8 (1.63), which comes to a 61.5% probability. Meanwhile, the average odds on over 2.5 total goals are 11/8 (2.38), which is 42.1% in terms of probability. A good first goalscorer bet looks to be the aging Luis Suarez who is priced at around 5/1 (6.00) and if you fancy both teams to score, the odds are currently at around 6/5 (2.20).
